_about: 2-18 (R1 fix 1; re-authored in step 133): antiportal_1138 (scale 3.6, 115.2 px at 32 x scale) covers
block00_1141 and the lift's foot, and antiportal_1237 (scale 3.9, 124.8 px) covers the door room with
anti_portal_agent_ent_1238 at its centre. The agent can be shot only from high over the upper floor
with door_lift_1146 raised, and button_1148 raises it all the way from crate_no_emissive_ent_1135's
press, and it falls once the crate is gone. Up the lower floor to block00 (portals at (32, 236), (150, 306), (348, 268), (80, 306)) and onto
lift_ent_1142, and ride it. A portal over the button (320, 125) from the lift's top on 1670 and one
beside the crate (68, 258) from its foot on 1757: the crate enters the second portal as it opens (a
crate already sitting in the first does not go), drops onto the button on 1798, and the door rises.
The lift's 175-tick shuttle and carranca_right_1075's 3000 ms stride drift 5 ticks a cycle, and the
crate burns 60 ticks after the next fireball reaches it; at this foot the rest fits before the door
drops on 1927, and each earlier foot leaves 5 ticks less. A portal at (255, 83) from the rising lift
on 1840 (from 1833 that flatter shot ends inside antiportal_1138's ring); left onto single_block_1208
and off its edge, a portal at (365, 146) under the fall; out of (255, 85) and up. STEP 133: the lift
door rises 0.8 x 128 = 102.4 as the original's does, not the port's old 126, so its bottom stands at
56.6 and the old kill line from (247.7, 37.7) toward (54, 76) meets it. The exit portal is 13 px
lower so that the player is at (247.7, 50.8) on 1892, and the shot toward (54, 72) passes about
0.4 px under the raised door's bottom, about 0.3 px over the settled barrel's left corner (120.7,
65.0) and 21.6 px from the agent (R17's 22.4): agent and ring gone on 1908. A window that narrow is
the geometry's, not the tuning's: no line clears the door's bottom corner, the barrel's corner and
the agent's 22.4 each by more than about 0.5 px. A portal in the door room at (60, 20), over the
barrel by 4.5 px, on 1916 while the door is still up, and one under the landed player (248, 146) on
1940; out at (60, 22), down onto the door. Won on tick 1965. Leans on the port's traversal by body
overlap (the crate; the player into (365, 146); the player under a portal opened on him), on R17's
kill by a shot aimed into the field, and on the fireball ending at the crate and burning it. The
level's reflector (reflect_agent_1180) is not used; how the original reaches the agent is not shown.
